text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I had a wonderful dream last night, 
you see...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
A spiral staircase stretching into the 
azure sky... and beneath it, a golden sea 
spreading far and wide—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm going to keep running endlessly, 
together with my "friend"...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I hope I get to see it again... ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having had a fun dream, she seemed to feel 
completely refreshed!
